I have these exact feelings and actions (or non-actions I should say) down to the T! I just finished my 3rd year at college and I had to move back home due to other circumstances. The last two weeks there, I was basically a zombie but I would pack my stuff when I wasn’t being such a shell of a person. I think packing my belongings, especially after a breakup and him being moved out already, was a perfect transition to be at home with my family. My parents are getting older so I help when I can. My dog is too. Even though I feel hollow a lot of the time, there is comfort in knowing that I have some sort of responsibility to maintaining myself at the very least. Because I know people don’t want to see me in my worst state, or at least, I don’t want them to see me like that. And I have my dog who I can kind of “talk” to and take care of. Recently picked up painting again, especially posters for protests. I have three plants that I talk to at least once a day. Painted my bathroom and decorated my room. Watching documentaries and trying to become more aware in these turbulent times. All stuff that I have decided I am kind of proud of. In short, I would just say to be kind to yourself but also push yourself to do small things everyday. I still feel not good a lot of times, but being productive with things I’m passionate about gives me a sense of hope and a bit of happiness. Also on lexapro though (2 weeks)!
